verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is a terminal coding agent, so a project instructions file for coding standards is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents such a file (e.g., an AGENTS.md-style config) or any mechanism for setting conventions the agent follows. The docs cover approval policies, sandboxing, headless exec, models and slash commands, none of which is this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows
